## What's Changed

* Prefer regular applications when resolving app names, avoiding same-name background helpers. [#61](https://github.com/iFurySt/open-codex-computer-use/pull/61)
* Support Safari custom accessibility action names and prevent secondary actions from resolving to the wrong action after filtering or name collisions. [#62](https://github.com/iFurySt/open-codex-computer-use/pull/62)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/iFurySt/open-codex-computer-use/compare/v0.3.3...v0.3.4
